key.name: backend-path
key.summary: Path to the codexbar CLI executable.
key.description: Leave empty to resolve the 'codexbar' CLI from $PATH.

key.name: refresh-frequency
key.description: One of manual, oneMinute, twoMinutes, fiveMinutes, fifteenMinutes, thirtyMinutes.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Kept for migration from the earlier Linux extension skeleton.

key.name: launch-at-login
key.description: Create a GNOME autostart entry that enables the extension on session startup.

key.name: debug-menu-enabled
key.description: Controls visibility of the Debug preferences page.

key.name: debug-file-logging-enabled
key.description: Mirrors upstream file logging preference.

key.name: debug-log-level
key.description: One of trace, verbose, debug, info, warning, error, critical.

key.name: debug-loading-pattern
key.description: Empty means random/default. Otherwise one of knightRider, cylon, outsideIn, race, pulse, unbraid.

key.name: debug-keep-cli-sessions-alive
key.description: Debug toggle mirroring upstream CLI session keep-alive behavior.

key.name: debug-injected-error
key.description: Non-empty text is displayed as a fake backend error in the menu.

key.name: status-checks-enabled
key.description: Poll provider status pages when the CLI surfaces status information.

key.name: session-quota-notifications-enabled
key.description: Notify when a session quota depletes or restores.

key.name: usage-bars-show-used
key.description: When true, usage bars fill as consumed usage instead of remaining quota.

key.name: reset-times-show-absolute
key.description: Use absolute clock labels instead of countdown labels.

key.name: menu-bar-shows-brand-icon-with-percent
key.summary: Show provider brand icon with percent.
key.description: Replace critter bars with provider badge and display text.

key.name: menu-bar-display-mode
key.description: One of percent, pace, both.

key.name: historical-tracking-enabled
key.description: Reserved for upstream-compatible historical pace tracking.

key.name: show-all-token-accounts-in-menu
key.summary: Show all token accounts in menu.
key.description: Reserve menu layout for all token accounts instead of compact switching.

key.name: menu-bar-metric-preferences
key.description: Provider id to automatic, primary, secondary, tertiary, extraUsage, or average.

key.name: cost-usage-enabled
key.description: Show local token cost summaries when the CLI returns them.

key.name: hide-personal-info
key.description: Redact account emails from the menu.

key.name: random-blink-enabled
key.description: Enable idle blink, wiggle, and tilt animation.

key.name: confetti-on-weekly-limit-resets-enabled
key.description: Reserved for upstream parity; GNOME port does not render Vortex confetti.

key.name: menu-bar-shows-highest-usage
key.description: Use the provider closest to a rate limit for the merged panel icon.

key.name: claude-web-extras-enabled
key.description: Show optional Claude web details when provided by the CLI.

key.name: claude-peak-hours-enabled
key.description: Show Claude peak-hour notes in the menu card.

key.name: show-optional-credits-and-extra-usage
key.summary: Show optional credits and extra usage.
key.description: Show Codex credits and Claude extra usage sections.

key.name: open-ai-web-access-enabled
key.description: Allow OpenAI web usage output when returned by the CLI.

key.name: open-ai-web-battery-saver-enabled
key.description: Reserved for lighter OpenAI web refresh behavior.

key.name: provider-storage-footprints-enabled
key.description: Show provider storage facts when available.

key.name: jetbrains-ide-base-path
key.description: Optional path used by JetBrains provider discovery.

key.name: merge-icons
key.description: Use one merged GNOME panel button.

key.name: switcher-shows-icons
key.description: Show provider icon badges in switcher buttons.

key.name: merged-menu-last-selected-was-overview
key.description: Tracks whether the merged menu shows the Overview tab.

key.name: merged-overview-selected-providers
key.description: Up to three provider ids shown in the Overview tab.

key.name: selected-menu-provider
key.description: Provider id shown by default in the merged menu.

key.name: default-provider
key.description: Kept for migration from the previous extension skeleton.

key.name: provider-detection-completed
key.description: Tracks whether provider detection has been acknowledged.

key.name: enabled-providers
key.description: Provider ids shown by the GNOME extension.

key.name: provider-source-modes
key.description: Provider id to auto, web, oauth, cli, or api.

key.name: provider-option-toggles
key.description: Provider id to true or false for generic provider settings rows.

key.name: provider-token-labels
key.description: Provider id to manually entered token account label.

key.name: codex-active-account
key.description: GNOME-side preference for the Codex account section.

key.name: auto-update-enabled
key.description: GNOME extension updates are managed outside the extension.

key.name: update-channel
key.description: Stable or beta.
